svg.title: The Archive — the unsorted library, and the readers who did not leave.
svg.desc: A vast library receding into darkness: four ranks of shelves rise toward a ceiling that is only a rumor, every shelf crammed with leather-and-parchment spines shoved out of order — pushed and pulled along their boards, overlapping and gapped, not one title legible. A muted lantern-glow pools low and warm; everything above is near-black. On the floor before the shelves lie three fallen initiates in the tatters of their robes, at rest among a few scattered bones — one slumped against an upright with a satchel of careful notes, one lying with an arm still reaching toward a shelf, and one sitting as if it had only stopped to rest, cradling a single illuminated page that yet burns with gold leaf and blue ink, the one bright thing in the room. When the shelves are set right the spines slide home into even ranks and their gilded titles bloom back along the leather, name after name.
